text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 175 syringes of insulin aspart 100 units/mL 3 mL with 15 days of supply at 11.7 syringes per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 19 syringes with 5.3 days of supply at 3.6 syringes per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include insulin aspart as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale Lakeside is below one week. Corvale General can spare inventory without dropping below two weeks. No national shortage is reported by FDA.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 11 syringes of 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
2. Place purchase order with Novo Nordisk Inc. (800 Scudders Mill Road, Plainsboro) — requires buyer.
3. Place purchase order with Biocon Biologics Inc. — requires buyer.
4. Place purchase order with Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer.
5. Place purchase order with Novo Nordisk Pharma, Inc. — requires buyer.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new purchase deliveries.
